item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 13/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to southern China in the next couple of days. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southern China towards the weekend. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region. Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, it will be warm and misty over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week.
